notes: risk_of_disabling: how much harm turning this OFF causes. Drives the confirmation copy in the admin UI.
depends_on: disabling a parent warns about (and can cascade to) its dependents.
targeting: which targeting types this module supports. 'global' is always implied.
sub_settings_schema: JSON Schema fragment. The admin UI generates the settings form from it.
